experiments.title: End-to-end instrumentation smoke test
experiments.question: Can the complete experimental pipeline train, evaluate, checkpoint, and capture metrics without contaminating the shared baseline?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: List the files and metrics that must exist for this run to count as valid.

experiments.title: Short d6 control
experiments.question: What do healthy loss, validation BPB, throughput, and early samples look like under the standard d6 configuration?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict validation BPB at steps 0, 100, 300, and 600 and define an instability threshold.

experiments.title: Full M3 Max d6 baseline
experiments.question: What performance does the official Mac-scale training budget establish as the course control?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Pre-register final validation BPB, throughput range, and two qualitative capabilities before launching.

experiments.title: Tokenizer vocabulary 8K
experiments.question: Does a smaller vocabulary improve parameter efficiency enough to offset longer token sequences at fixed token budget?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict compression ratio, embedding parameter count, BPB, and why token-count comparisons alone are invalid.

experiments.title: Tokenizer vocabulary 16K
experiments.question: Is 16K vocabulary a better compression/capacity compromise than 8K and 32K at this scale?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: State the expected ordering for bytes/token, model parameters, step time, and validation BPB.

experiments.title: Tokenizer vocabulary 32K
experiments.question: Does 32K vocabulary earn enough compression to justify its embedding and value-embedding parameter cost at this model scale?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict compression, parameter count, bytes processed at a fixed token budget, and validation BPB against the 8K and 16K conditions.

experiments.title: Global learning-rate scale 0.5x
experiments.question: Does halving every optimizer-group learning rate improve stability at the cost of slower learning?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict early slope, final BPB, and whether 600 steps is long enough to judge the lower rate.

experiments.title: Global learning-rate scale 2x
experiments.question: Does doubling every optimizer-group learning rate converge faster without instability?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Define a divergence criterion using both loss and validation BPB before running.

experiments.title: No learning-rate warmup
experiments.question: Is warmup necessary for this small model and optimizer at batch size 16K tokens?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict the first 50 steps and distinguish transient instability from permanent damage.

experiments.title: Long 200-step warmup
experiments.question: Does a warmup consuming one third of a short budget protect optimization or waste scarce updates?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict crossover step versus the standard 40-step warmup.

experiments.title: Constant vs linear-warmdown vs cosine schedule
experiments.question: At equal update count and peak learning rate, which schedule gives the best final BPB and which gives the best anytime performance?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Sketch all three multiplier curves and pre-register area-under-curve and final-BPB predictions.

implementation_contract.cli: Add --lr-schedule with choices linear, cosine, constant; preserve linear as default.
invariants: final_lr_frac honored for linear and cosine
implementation_contract.test: Unit-test multipliers at start, warmup boundary, midpoint, and final step.

experiments.title: All-AdamW vs hybrid Muon/AdamW
experiments.question: Does Muon improve quality per step, quality per wall-clock minute, or both?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Specify which parameter groups are controlled, how learning rates are tuned fairly, and what optimizer state memory you expect.

implementation_contract.cli: Add --optimizer with choices hybrid_muon and adamw.
invariants: parameter initialization and data order are unchanged
log optimizer name and peak memory
implementation_contract.test: Verify every trainable parameter appears in exactly one optimizer group for both choices.

experiments.title: Zero matrix weight decay
experiments.question: Does regularization help within a short, undertrained regime?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict train loss, validation BPB, and weight-norm direction separately.

experiments.title: Double matrix weight decay
experiments.question: When does stronger decay become underfitting rather than useful regularization?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Explain the repository's automatic weight-decay scaling before predicting the result.

experiments.title: Gradient clipping threshold sweep
experiments.question: Does clipping prevent rare destructive updates, or does it continuously shrink useful gradients?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Choose thresholds only after measuring the unclipped gradient-norm distribution.

implementation_contract.cli: Add --grad-clip where -1 disables clipping and positive values are global-norm thresholds.
invariants: log pre-clip norm and clipped fraction
implementation_contract.test: Construct a deterministic two-parameter model and verify the post-clip global norm.

experiments.title: 8K-token total batch
experiments.question: How does a smaller batch change noise, update count per token, and throughput?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Explain why nanochat's automatic LR scaling makes this a training-policy comparison, not a pure batch-only intervention.

experiments.title: 32K-token total batch
experiments.question: Does doubling batch tokens improve hardware use enough to compensate for half as many parameter updates at fixed steps?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: State whether you will compare fixed steps, fixed tokens, or fixed wall-clock—and why.

experiments.title: Quarter training horizon
experiments.question: What fraction of final baseline quality is acquired in the first quarter of tokens?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict final BPB and marginal BPB improvement per million tokens.

experiments.title: Double training horizon
experiments.question: Does the d6 model remain data-limited at 5K steps, and what is the marginal return of another 81.9M tokens?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Estimate the power-law improvement and define an early-stop rule from the validation curve.

experiments.title: Eight layers at approximately fixed width
experiments.question: At similar residual width, does added depth improve quality enough to justify extra FLOPs?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Calculate n_embd, heads, approximate parameter change, and expected step-time change before running.

experiments.title: Width 512 at six layers
experiments.question: At fixed depth, how does extra width compare with added depth under a short budget?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Compare at fixed steps, then explain why a fixed-FLOP follow-up is required.

experiments.title: Four attention heads at width 384
experiments.question: At fixed residual width, does using fewer, wider heads change optimization or representation quality?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Calculate head dimension and identify which parameter matrices do and do not change size.

experiments.title: Three attention heads at width 384
experiments.question: How far can head count fall before reduced attention diversity hurts BPB?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict whether quality or throughput will move measurably at this scale.

experiments.title: MLP expansion-ratio sweep
experiments.question: At fixed depth and width, how should capacity be allocated between attention and feed-forward computation?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Compare ratios 2, 4, and 8 at fixed steps and then at approximately fixed FLOPs.

implementation_contract.cli: Add --mlp-ratio and persist it in GPTConfig/checkpoints.
invariants: parameter counts and FLOP estimate reflect the ratio
implementation_contract.test: Assert c_fc and c_proj shapes for ratios 2, 4, and 8.

experiments.title: Context length 256
experiments.question: At fixed tokens per update, does shorter context improve throughput at an unacceptable modeling cost?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict throughput, number of independent sequences per batch, and held-out BPB.

experiments.title: Context length 1024
experiments.question: At fixed tokens per update, does longer context improve BPB enough to justify quadratic attention cost?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict the throughput ratio using attention complexity, then explain deviations caused by MLP and overhead.

experiments.title: Tied vs untied token embeddings
experiments.question: Does sharing input and output embeddings improve parameter efficiency or constrain useful specialization?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Account for initialization, optimizer grouping, parameter count, and checkpoint aliasing.

implementation_contract.cli: Add --tie-embeddings and persist it in GPTConfig.
implementation_contract.test: Check data_ptr equality when tied and inequality when untied.

experiments.title: RMSNorm placement study
experiments.question: How do pre-norm, post-norm, and embedding normalization affect gradient flow and stability?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Draw each residual path and predict gradient-norm behavior before coding.

implementation_contract.cli: Add --norm-placement with choices pre, post, and pre_plus_embedding.
invariants: current behavior is preserved by pre_plus_embedding
each path applies exactly the intended norms
implementation_contract.test: Use hooks to count norm calls and verify tensor shapes for every mode.

experiments.title: ReLU-squared vs GELU vs SwiGLU
experiments.question: Which activation gives the best quality per parameter and per FLOP at Mac scale?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: The current baseline is ReLU-squared, not GELU. Choose hidden sizes that make both raw and parameter-matched comparisons possible.

implementation_contract.cli: Add --activation with choices relu2, gelu, swiglu.
implementation_contract.test: Verify output shapes, parameter counts, and finite backward passes for all choices.

experiments.title: RoPE base and rotated-fraction study
experiments.question: How do RoPE frequency choices interact with training context and length extrapolation?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict in-distribution BPB separately from evaluation beyond the training context.

invariants: default base 100000 and fraction 1 preserve current behavior
implementation_contract.test: Verify relative-position identity, cache shape, and forward pass at train and extrapolation lengths.

experiments.title: Data quality and mixture intervention
experiments.question: Can a smaller, higher-quality or domain-targeted mixture outperform more generic tokens on the metrics that matter?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Define mixture provenance, deduplication, contamination checks, and both general and domain evaluations before training.

implementation_contract.cli: Add a data manifest argument rather than hard-coding source paths.
invariants: validation data is fixed and excluded from every mixture
implementation_contract.test: On a synthetic two-source corpus, verify empirical sampling weights and zero validation overlap.

experiments.title: Supervised fine-tuning baseline
experiments.question: Which behaviors improve after SFT, and what base-model behavior or knowledge regresses?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Choose one held-out loss metric, one format-following metric, and one capability metric before training.

experiments.title: Math-heavy SFT mixture
experiments.question: How does increasing GSM8K exposure trade mathematical behavior against broader instruction following?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict GSM8K, categorical ChatCORE, and validation BPB changes; define catastrophic forgetting.

experiments.title: Implement and validate DPO
experiments.question: How do preference strength, beta, and rejected-response quality alter alignment and capability retention?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Derive the DPO loss from the policy/reference log-ratio and identify every tensor that must be detached.

implementation_contract.cli: Create scripts/chat_dpo.py with --beta, --num-iterations, and explicit train/validation preference files.
invariants: log preference accuracy and KL proxy
implementation_contract.test: Hand-compute a two-pair batch and match the implementation loss and gradient signs.

experiments.title: GSM8K policy-gradient baseline
experiments.question: Does on-policy verifiable-reward training improve pass@1 rather than merely pass@k or response length?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Predict reward, pass@1, pass@4, sequence length, and one plausible reward-hacking behavior.

experiments.title: RL group size eight
experiments.question: Does a larger within-question sample group improve the advantage signal enough to justify rollout cost?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Compare reward variance, usable nonzero advantages, wall-clock time, and pass@1.

experiments.title: M3 Max Parameter Golf capstone
experiments.question: What combination of independently validated interventions minimizes held-out BPB under a fixed 30-minute wall-clock budget?
experiments.hypothesis_prompt: Freeze hardware, data, evaluation, timer boundary, and artifact-size rule before selecting interventions.

implementation_contract.constraint: 30 minutes measured training time on this M3 Max; no external compute; fixed validation split.
implementation_contract.grading: 40% rigor, 25% BPB, 15% reproducibility, 10% efficiency analysis, 10% communication.
